definitions: The part of the alimentary canal and respiratory tract that extends from the back of the nasal cavity and mouth to the esophagus and larynx.
The muscular tube that connects the nasal and oral cavities to the esophagus and larynx, serving as a passageway for both air and food.
examples: The pharynx is a crucial part of the throat.
Food passes through the pharynx before reaching the esophagus.
Air travels through the pharynx to the larynx.
